newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INTERVIEW - Telkom sees 1996 revenues up.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Telkom sees 1996 revenues up.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) said on Friday it expected revenue growth of 15-25 percent in 1996 from 5.11 trillion rupiah in 1995.
"Revenue growth this year is expected to be in the range between 15 percent to 25 percent," Telkom president director and chief executive officer Asman Akhir Nasution told Reuters.
Telkom posted operating revenues of 5.11 trillion rupiah in 1995 against 4.04 trillion rupiah in 1994 and 3.07 trillion rupiah in 1993.
It posted operating revenues of 2.38 trillion rupiah in the first-half of 1996 against 2.36 trillion rupiah in the same period of last year.
Nasution denied market speculation that Telkom coming roadshow later this month was an effort to promote the selling of additional shares, adding that the firm was in strong financial condition.
